Open is one row per symbol+system: average cost across add-on buys, first buy date. Trims reduce shares only (no Closed row) until remaining shares hit zero. Rows come from gettarget_positions.csv (system purchases) plus any other open lots ≥ $47.5K that are not listed in personal_holdings_exclude.csv or sold_symbols_blocklist.csv. Sold blocklist permanently hides a ticker from Open (even if a stub Fidelity export or engine map would resurrect it) until you delete it from the blocklist and re-add gettarget. Action flags profit-lock trim/sell when unrealized ≥8% (or ≥50% of the way to target) / ≥15% or at target — also listed under Pending sells.
